about: Duckett Creek-Missouri River drains about 21 square miles, 72% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 680 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 430 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Duckett Creek and Taylor Branch. St. Charles County communities here include St. Charles and St. Peters. Downstream, its water passes through the Cowmire Creek-Missouri River and Outlet Missouri River watersheds on its way down the Missouri River, which joins the Mississippi River at the east end of St. Charles County.
